name: Ask Before Building (Zero Burden)
subject: A Simple Website Can Bring More Customers?
body:
Hi {{clientName}},

I found your business on Google today. You have a great profile!

I noticed your business doesn’t currently have a website. Having a simple website is one of the easiest ways to build trust, attract more customers, and give your business a more professional online presence.

I would love to create a free design mockup to show how professional your business could look online.

If you're interested, we can schedule a quick demo call where I can show you a sample based on your requirements. If you like it, we can discuss things further from there.

Let me know if you'd like to see a sample.

Best,
Devansh Sahu

name: Thumbnail First Outreach
subject: Thumbnail Design Idea For Your Channel
body:
Hi {{clientName}},

I recently came across your content and really liked your work.

I specialize in YouTube thumbnail design and create high-quality, eye-catching thumbnails designed to improve clicks and engagement on videos.

I’d love to share a few sample thumbnail ideas based on your content style. If you'd like, I can also share some of my previous work here.

Also, if you ever plan to improve, redesign, or create a website for your brand, I can help with that as well based on your requirements.

Best,
Devansh Sahu
